Raymond James Financial: The fiscal 2025 10-K states its independent contractor financial advisors are generally responsible for all of their direct costs and, accordingly, receive a higher payout percentage on the revenues they generate than employee financial advisors; they may affiliate directly or through an affiliated bank or credit union in the Financial Institutions Division.

Raymond James Financial: The fiscal 2025 10-K states that through its domestic RCS division it offers third-party RIAs and broker-dealers custodial services, trade execution, research and other support, and that financial advisors associated with RCS firms are not included in its financial advisor counts.

Raymond James Financial: On the earnings call for the period ended June 30, 2026, management said Raymond James has the largest addressable market in the industry because it offers all the affiliation options an advisor could want, and that it is agnostic about how an advisor affiliates with Raymond James.

Raymond James Financial: On the earnings call for the period ended December 31, 2025, management said Raymond James has the largest addressable market across its affiliation options—employee, independent contractor, and RIA custody—with critical mass and decades of experience in each, and that it is not a new venture for the firm.

Raymond James Financial: On the earnings call for the period ended September 30, 2024, CEO Paul Reilly said on the affiliation mix that RCS has by far the highest percentage growth, that this year the employee channel led the way, and that he expected some improvement in the independent contractor model.

Raymond James Financial: On the earnings call for the period ended June 30, 2025, Raymond James said the acceleration rate within the independent channel is probably higher, while it is still seeing success in the employee affiliation option and the independent RIA option.

Raymond James Financial: On the earnings call for the period ended December 31, 2025, Raymond James said recruiting activity is robust and broad-based across its affiliation options, but has been more heavily tilted toward the independent contractor side over the last six months.

Raymond James Financial: On the earnings call for the period ended March 31, 2026, Raymond James said it is seeing a good uptick in the employee affiliation option, and that the mix shift it referenced concerns the comp ratio (not margin) because of the payout difference between the independent and employee channels.

Raymond James Financial: On the earnings call for the period ended June 30, 2026, Raymond James said the affiliation options differ in how advisors spend their time day-to-day: the employee option suits those focused on building their books of business, while others want to run a business, including building a team, paying benefits, and dealing with real estate and legal aspects.

Raymond James Financial: Trade press (published October 29, 2026) reports CEO Paul Shoukry said the firm's recruiting success is spread across all its affiliation channels, with the independent contractor channel seeing the most interest in dollar volume, while the RIA custody division is growing at a high percentage rate on a smaller base.

Raymond James Financial: On the earnings call for the period ended June 30, 2026, management said Raymond James has the largest addressable market in the industry because it offers all the affiliation options an advisor could want, that it is agnostic about how an advisor affiliates, and that it wants advisors to fall in love with its culture, values, platform and capabilities.

Raymond James Financial: The fiscal 2025 10-K states Raymond James offers multiple affiliation options, referred to as AdvisorChoice®, and that financial advisors primarily affiliate directly as employees or independent contractors, or as employees of third-party RIAs and broker-dealers served through its RCS division.

Raymond James Financial: On its affiliation-options web page (page content as of April 21, 2026), Raymond James says that through AdvisorChoice advisors can match their professional goals to the affiliation option that is right for them, each offering a unique combination of support, freedom and flexibility backed by the full support of a leading independent financial firm.

Raymond James Financial: On the earnings calls for the periods ended March 31, 2025 and September 30, 2025, Raymond James described its best-of-both-worlds value proposition as a unique combination of an advisor- and client-focused culture coupled with leading technology and solutions, which it says resonates with advisors across all of its affiliation options.

Raymond James Financial: In its 2025 Investor Day deck (published June 5, 2025), Raymond James lists its value proposition pillars as a service-first culture, respect for financial advisor independence, and a comprehensive and growing product and solution set.

Raymond James Financial: On the earnings call for the period ended June 30, 2026, Raymond James said its affiliation strategy lets advisors not have to choose between culture and capabilities, offering an advisor- and client-focused culture along with leading technology, products and solutions.

Raymond James Financial: The fiscal 2025 10-K states Raymond James' independent contractor financial advisor options are designed to help its advisors build their businesses with as much or as little of its support as they determine they need.

Raymond James Financial: In its 2025 Investor Day deck (published June 5, 2025), Raymond James describes its mission for the affiliation models as to inspire and empower the world's best financial professionals, tied to multiple affiliation options, best of both worlds, advisor and book ownership, and RJF stability.

Raymond James Financial: The fiscal 2025 10-K states Raymond James competes directly with national full service broker-dealers, investment banking firms, commercial banks, investment advisors, investment managers and, to a lesser extent, discount brokers and dealers; it faces competition from more recent entrants including fintechs, as well as indirect competition for investment assets from insurance companies, real estate firms and hedge funds.

Raymond James Financial: The fiscal 2025 10-K states the continued industry-wide trend of financial advisors departing traditional firms—including to form independent RIAs or join existing third-party RIAs, some of which are backed by private equity investors—has resulted in a highly competitive recruiting environment for its PCG business.

Raymond James Financial: On the earnings call for the period ended September 30, 2025, Raymond James said many of its competitors are increasingly looking for an exit in three to five years or less, many compete with the largest check, and many change their comp plans every year to cross-sell more bank products.

Raymond James Financial: On the earnings call for the period ended June 30, 2025, Raymond James named PE-backed roll-ups as a relatively novel competitive dynamic, saying they have been extremely aggressive over the last three years in paying higher and higher multiples for advisors.

Raymond James Financial: On the earnings call for the period ended June 30, 2025, Raymond James said it still sees pressure on the existing advisor base from private equity roll-ups, which in the absence of a value proposition compete with big checks.

Raymond James Financial: On the earnings call for the period ended December 31, 2025, Raymond James said there are more competitive pressures now with private equity-backed roll-ups and that sort of thing.

Raymond James Financial: On the earnings call for the period ended December 31, 2025, Raymond James said many competitors that focus on personal relationships and have similar cultures invest only a fraction of what it does in technology, making it hard for them to remain competitive.

Raymond James Financial: On the earnings call for the period ended June 30, 2026, Raymond James said it does not lead with the highest check, and that competitors that lack a true differentiated value proposition lead with the highest check.

Raymond James Financial: On the earnings call for the period ended December 31, 2025, Raymond James said advisors are coming to it from a lot of different competitor firms, including wirehouses, regionals and other independents.

Raymond James Financial: On the earnings call for the period ended March 31, 2026, Raymond James said private equity has certainly been competitive over the last five years, as well as some of the strategic firms.

Raymond James Financial: The fiscal 2025 10-K notes it is possible that certain of its competitors will withdraw from the Protocol for Broker Recruiting, which governs the client information advisors may take when they affiliate with a new firm.
